prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1188; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's okay. Can we just refer to me as the claimant?

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Conroe, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the front entrance, going slowly.

Q: What happened next?

A: A pickup backed out of the space across from me and didn't see my car. I hit the brakes but he hit the rear quarter panel of my vehicle. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Did you hit anything inside the vehicle?

A: My head hit the side window, I think. I didn't lose consciousness, but I felt dizzy and my neck was stiff right away.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, a paramedic checked me at the scene, and then I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. They diagnosed a concussion and told me to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Are you still having symptoms?

A: Yes. I get headaches in the afternoon, I'm sensitive to bright light, and I've had trouble concentrating at work. I've been out of the office for a few days.

Q: Have you had any prior head injuries or neck problems?

A: No, nothing that I can recall. I was healthy before this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that the other driver admitted at the scene that he hadn't checked his mirror. I'd like my vehicle damage and medical costs to be covered.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
